coverage_note: All 14 numbered pages were supplied. Figure pixels and underlying interview data were unavailable, but the text sufficiently supports this review.

findings.reference_quote: Of the 20 participants, 14 were pregnant women—4 primiparous and 10 multiparous.
findings.explanation: The summary overstates the number of pregnant participants. The methods specify 20 participants total: 14 pregnant women, one expecting father, and five elderly community members. Although the abstract uses similar shorthand, the detailed participant breakdown establishes the actual sample.
